name: Neo4j AuraDB

evidence.nosql: C02: primary type is native property-graph database queried with Cypher
evidence.vector: V01: vector indexes support 1 to 4,096 dimensions with HNSW indexing and cosine or Euclidean similarity

line: Graph database for connected app data, with vector and full-text search.

free.text: 1GB; 200K nodes/400K rels; pauses at 72h idle; deletes after 30d paused

cells.regions: AWS, Azure, GCP; tier and SKU availability varies

sql.math: 2 GB × 730 hours × $0.09 per GB an hour. Whether the vector data and index fit, and whether compute speed is enough, are not proven.
A running 2 GB primary costs $0.18 an hour, so 730 hours comes to $131.40. A 30-day pause plus 10 hours resumed is $27.72.

files.math: Neo4j does not provide general file or object storage.

jobs.math: AuraDB does not provide a general job runner.
